headline: BBVA México sees digitalization of the economy as positive, though expects resistance to its adoption
summary: BBVA Mexico views the digitalization of the economy positively but expects resistance to its adoption. The Finance Ministry is due to announce sectors where only electronic payments will be accepted under the Digital Economy Law.
why: BBVA Mexico is a major Mexican retail bank, and mandatory electronic payment rules would affect payment volumes and fee income across the sector.
original_headline: BBVA México ve positiva la digitalización de la economía, aunque prevé resistencia en su adopción
